title: Design a bounded long run for the qualified winning recipe
doing: Design one frozen recipe with at least2 training seeds, independent equal-frame entry qualification, raw-frame schedules, rotating fresh development looks, per-update health telemetry, every-update full-state checkpoints and averaged-weight copies, noise-aware plateau/collapse rules, independent final confirmation and hard work/resource caps. No seed reservation, lease disposition, launch or automatic recovery is authorized.
expected: If tuning found a recipe with sustained learning, current-policy Q1 and Mean should improve against frozen entry/incumbent controls on new cohorts. Plateau, regressions or resource bottlenecks remain possible; an increasing best-so-far curve is not proof of continued current-policy learning, and two training seeds provide limited population certainty.
actual: Prepared P5 bounded design: prospective equal-frame two-replica recipe entry; two long trajectories up to117,964,800 additional frames each; six fresh1024-seed current/incumbent looks; independent2048-seed final confirmation. Long-run ceiling28h50m excludes entry; total new evaluation seeds requested9216, none reserved/opened. Source readiness blockers remain. No training outcome observed.
next_step: Keep Phase0/1 priority work and held S1 incident intact. Freeze the winning recipe, schedules and exact bounds only after measurements; complete source/review/full-state/resource gates, then seek Taylor explicit go-ahead.
